llm_top3.reasoning: KIM (rank 1) is confirmed by fundamentals rather than just 13F noise: record occupancy, 12% dividend hike and raised FFO guidance. I skip META (rank 2, mostly settlement-relief already priced with heavy AI spend) and SCHW (rank 3, actively hit by Vanguard's Altruist competitive threat and insider selling) in favor of AMT, where a Barclays upgrade plus a rare open-market director buy and steep discount-to-fair-value framing offer a cleaner catalyst, and EQH, which beat Q2 with record AUMA, accretive Corebridge merger math and multiple analyst target raises. LFST was a close call on news strength but is smaller and more volatile.

KIM.reasoning: Record occupancy, 12% dividend hike, raised 2026 FFO guidance and price target raises outweigh routine 13F filings.

META.reasoning: $17-18B teen safety settlement removes overhang (UBS reiterates buy, Reuters says money machine unscathed) but heavy AI spend and Needham strategy concerns temper it.

SCHW.reasoning: Vanguard's $4B Altruist acquisition triggered a sharp drop in wealth-management names, plus insider selling by co-chairman.

EQH.reasoning: Q2 beat, record AUMA, Corebridge merger accretion and multiple analyst PT raises (UBS to $68, Wells to $60), offset by mostly routine 13F noise.

ROKU.reasoning: Trading essentially as a Fox buyout arbitrage at ~$164 with JPMorgan neutral at $160 target—limited upside left.

KHC.reasoning: Mixed: Q2 beat and improved organic sales outlook versus declining volumes and operating income; mostly value/dividend chatter.

WT.reasoning: Strong Q2 (EPS +76%, revenue +57%), 52-week high, PT raised to $27, though some valuation-stretched calls.

ROL.reasoning: Down 7.8% post-earnings, printing 52-week lows on softer Q2 and cost realignment with guidance for a weak next quarter.

MRSH.reasoning: Q2 beat, buybacks, Accel acquisition and stock up 7.5% since earnings; headlines mostly routine institutional filings.

BX.reasoning: NVIDIA investment in Blackstone-backed Lancium and AI-financing role are positives, but large put OI increases and AI-credit-risk headlines cut both ways.

UDR.reasoning: Q2 FFO and revenue beat with raised 2026 guidance on leasing strength.

GT.reasoning: Only retail chatter about a California tire rule and trading noise; no confirmed material catalyst.

NOV.reasoning: Small Q2 EPS beat and 'still undervalued after 64% run' commentary, but revenue declined YoY and news is thin.

LYFT.reasoning: Court sanctions and malice finding in a driver injury case plus repeated CFO/insider selling and Tepper exiting outweigh undervaluation talk.

DBX.reasoning: Flat ~1% revenue growth, shrinking margins, Zacks Bear of the Day and persistent executive share sales.

KMB.reasoning: Kenvue deal is in regulatory review (EU filing, China SAMR Phase 2 hurdle), otherwise dividend-list filler.

CARR.reasoning: Down 7.4% in four weeks with persistent weakness and unfavorable comparisons to Trane, only contrarian bounce calls.

MAS.reasoning: EPS beat driven by tariff refunds but revenue missed and stock fell ~7%; D.A. Davidson initiated Neutral.

AMT.reasoning: Barclays upgrade to Overweight with $198 PT plus a $500K director open-market purchase and repeated deep-discount valuation calls.

CZR.reasoning: Fertitta take-private vote scheduled at a fixed price, so most of the deal move is behind it; management communication frustration noted.

CNM.reasoning: Repeated 'declines more than the market' headlines, Northcoast downgrade to Neutral and Wall Street Zen cut ahead of Q2.

GGG.reasoning: Record Q2 with modest growth and strong margins but guidance only low-single-digit organic; stock has since drifted lower.

FND.reasoning: Down 7.4% on Walmart-driven consumer caution, weak housing demand, negative Q3 comps and Goldman PT cut, despite an earlier guidance raise.

LFST.reasoning: Blowout Q2 (revenue +26%, EBITDA +94%, net income positive), raised guidance, $100M buyback and a Zacks upgrade to Buy.
